source='''def transform(grid):
    n, m = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    row_separators = [i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    col_separators = [j for j in range(m) if len({grid[i][j] for i in range(n)}) == 1]
    row_bounds = [-1] + row_separators + [n]
    col_bounds = [-1] + col_separators + [m]
    out = []
    for ri in range(len(row_bounds) - 1):
        row = []
        for ci in range(len(col_bounds) - 1):
            cells = [grid[r][c] for r in range(row_bounds[ri] + 1, row_bounds[ri + 1])
                     for c in range(col_bounds[ci] + 1, col_bounds[ci + 1])]
            counts = {color: cells.count(color) for color in set(cells)}
            background = max(counts, key=counts.get)
            exceptions = len(cells) - counts[background]
            row.append(1 if exceptions == 2 else background)
        out.append(row)
    return out
'''
